definitions.explanation: Water that is flowing, as from a tap or in a stream, as opposed to still water in a basin. Common in instructions for washing, thawing and first aid.

examples.japanese: {流水|りゅうすい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{洗|あら}う→洗う：00827_arau⟧。
⟦{冷凍|れいとう}→冷凍：11730_reitou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{流水|りゅうすい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{解凍|かいとう}→解凍：19085_kaitou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I thawed the frozen meat under running water.

examples.japanese: やけど⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦したら→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{流水|りゅうすい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{冷|ひ}やして→冷やす：02403_hiyasu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: If you burn yourself, cool the burn well under running water right away.

notes:
